name: x3_sym
title: Triplet exchangeabilities constructed from nucleotide exchangeabilities

args.name: a
args.description: The triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet

description: Construct exchangeabilities on a triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet, from nucleotide exchangeabilities. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide, with the same exchangeabilities at all three positions. Combine with F to supply triplet or codon frequencies and obtain a substitution model.
examples: HKY85_sym +> x3_sym +> F +> dNdS      # equivalent to GY94
